items.title: The New York Knicks plan to waive two-way forward Kevin McCullar Jr, league sources told HoopsHype. McCullar spent two seasons with the Knicks and got his championship ring on opening night.

quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text: The New York Knicks plan to sign Dalton Knecht to a two-way deal, league sources told HoopsHype. Knecht, the 17th overall pick of the 2024 NBA Draft, averaged 7.1 points on 46% shooting from the field and 37% shooting from 3-point range in two seasons with the Lakers.
